description:
Get ready to celebrate a birthday party like never before with Timpy Kids Birthday Party Game, the ultimate birthday and cake games app for kids to have a blast and wish happy birthdays! With four exciting birthday party and baking cake games to play, the fun never ends! 

Now make birthdays exciting again! Make birthday celebrations memorable by planning the entire party for your friends. Surprise them with a room full of friends holding their favorite birthday cake. Eat, laugh, have loads of fun, and enjoy the day to the fullest.

You can play four fun birthday games in this Timpy Kids Birthday Party Game to make planning the birthday celebration week more exciting with party and cake games!

Cake Maker - Cake Decoration Game
In the Baking Cake Decoration game, let your imagination run wild as you choose from a variety of cake bases like red velvet, rainbow, chocolate, and more. Then, add some flavor to your cake with different colors and flavors of frosting, and top it off with lollipops, candies, and other fun decorations. Light up the party with candles, and voila, your cake creation is ready! Be brave and experiment with different flavors, toppings, and designs and bake your dream happy birthday cake. Wish the birthday boy or birthday girl a happy sweet sixteen with the most amazing and yummy birthday cake ever!

Greeting Card Decoration Game
Design your own customized happy birthday cards and send heartwarming wishes to your friend with the greeting card decoration game! Choose from a variety of layouts, and add images of cakes, numbered candles, and cute items like birthday hats and cupcakes to make the card more interesting and exciting. Add your own touch by tidying off the edges of the happy birthday card by cutting off edges and creating an envelope, then seal it with an image of your favorite character.

Dress Up Game for Girls
Get your characters ready for the party in stunning outfits and birthday costumes with the Dress Up Game for Girls! Choose from a colorful array of outfits and accessories like shoes, hats, and more to make your character the life of the party. Create unique looks that will turn heads and get your character lots of compliments.

Happy Birthday Gift Packing Game
In the Gift Packing game, choose the perfect gift from a range of toys, dolls, stuffed animals, and more as a happy birthday present for the birthday boy or birthday girl. Place the gift in a box by playing a fun shadow-matching game, wrap it up in beautiful wrapping paper, complete with a beautiful bow, and give it to your friend. Can you imagine the smile on their face when they see the birthday gift that you brought for them?

Happy Birthday Party Preparation Game
Finally, in the Happy Birthday Party Preparation game, help decorate the place and prepare for the party with fun shadow-matching decoration games, dot-to-dot cake games, shadow-matching balloon games, and gift puzzle games. Give the birthday boy or birthday girl the most amazing birthday celebrations and surprises, and have them smiling all day long.

Here's why our Timpy Birthday Party Game is perfect for your little one:

- They can plan the entire party from scratch, from making their very own birthday cake in their favorite flavor, color, toppings, and design, selecting gifts for the birthday boy or birthday girl, creating stunning birthday cards, and dressing up the cute and friendly characters in stunning birthday outfits.
- Fun games like shadow matching, dot-to-dot, and more are a great way for kids to build essential skills like creativity, problem-solving, focus, concentration, and imagination, among others.
- These fun happy birthday games are a great way to keep your little one engaged and entertained all day long.
- Our birthday games feature 100% kid-safe content.

So, get ready to celebrate and say happy birthday to you like never before with the Timpy Birthday Party Game! Download today and have a blast creating your own special birthday memories!
